statements.text: The array model shall use reference points $$voc_ref_V$$, $$isc_ref_A$$, $$vmp_ref_V$$ and $$imp_ref_A$$ at irradiance $$reference_irradiance_W_m2$$ and temperature $$reference_temperature_C$$.
statements.condition: 0 < vmp_ref_V < voc_ref_V and 0 < imp_ref_A < isc_ref_A and reference_irradiance_W_m2 > 0 and reference_temperature_C > -273.15
statements.rationale: Synthetic test bench. Values and acceptance limits are illustrative test data. See analyses/README.md for the model and test setup. Equation or criterion basis: framework/requirements-ui/analyses/README.md.

statements.text: The array model shall apply voltage temperature coefficient $$voltage_temp_coeff_V_C$$, relative current temperature coefficient $$current_temp_coeff_per_C$$ and logarithmic irradiance coefficient $$voltage_log_coefficient_V$$.

statements.text: The tracker shall be assessed for $$duration_s$$ with a change at $$change_time_s$$ from irradiance $$irradiance_start_W_m2$$ and temperature $$temperature_start_C$$ to irradiance $$irradiance_end_W_m2$$ and temperature $$temperature_end_C$$.
statements.condition: duration_s > 0 and 0 <= change_time_s <= duration_s and irradiance_start_W_m2 >= 0 and irradiance_end_W_m2 >= 0 and temperature_start_C > -273.15 and temperature_end_C > -273.15
statements.rationale: Synthetic test bench. Values and acceptance limits are illustrative test data. See analyses/README.md for the model and test setup. Equation or criterion basis: framework/requirements-ui/analyses/README.md. Initial irradiance uses the illumination maximum and final irradiance uses its interval mean. These are two constant test levels. They do not replay the orbital time history.

statements.rationale: Synthetic test bench. Values and acceptance limits are illustrative test data. See analyses/README.md for the model and test setup. Equation or criterion basis: framework/requirements-ui/analyses/README.md.

statements.text: The preliminary circular orbit shall have period $$orbit_period_s$$ at altitude $$altitude_km$$, using Earth radius $$earthRadius_km$$ and gravitational parameter $$gravitationalParameter_km3_s2$$.
statements.condition: (((((altitude_km > 0) and (earthRadius_km > 0)) and (gravitationalParameter_km3_s2 > 0)) and (orbit_period_s > 0)) and (orbit_period_s == ((2 * math.pi) * math.sqrt((((earthRadius_km + altitude_km) ** 3) / gravitationalParameter_km3_s2)))))
statements.rationale: Synthetic test bench. Values and acceptance limits are illustrative test data. See analyses/README.md for the model and test setup. Equation or criterion basis: final_report/design-proposal.tex#eq:orbit-period (handpicked-0003, Eqs. 1-4).

statements.text: The preliminary circular orbit at altitude $$altitude_km$$ shall provide $$sunlight_s$$ of sunlight and $$eclipse_s$$ of eclipse per $$orbit_period_s$$ orbit, using Earth radius $$earthRadius_km$$ and horizon angle $$horizon_angle_rad$$.
statements.condition: (((((((((altitude_km > 0) and (earthRadius_km > 0)) and (orbit_period_s > 0)) and (sunlight_s > 0)) and (eclipse_s > 0)) and (horizon_angle_rad == math.acos((earthRadius_km / (earthRadius_km + altitude_km))))) and (sunlight_s == ((0.5 + (horizon_angle_rad / math.pi)) * orbit_period_s))) and (eclipse_s == ((0.5 - (horizon_angle_rad / math.pi)) * orbit_period_s))) and (abs(((sunlight_s + eclipse_s) - orbit_period_s)) <= (1e-9 * orbit_period_s)))
statements.rationale: Synthetic test bench. Values and acceptance limits are illustrative test data. See analyses/README.md for the model and test setup. Equation or criterion basis: final_report/design-proposal.tex#eq:sunlight-period, eq:eclipse-period, eq:eclipse-geometry.

statements.text: The positive sunlight and eclipse periods shall sum to $$orbit_period_s$$ within numerical tolerance.
statements.condition: ((((orbit_period_s > 0) and (sunlight_s > 0)) and (eclipse_s > 0)) and (abs(((sunlight_s + eclipse_s) - orbit_period_s)) <= (1e-9 * orbit_period_s)))
statements.rationale: Synthetic test bench. Values and acceptance limits are illustrative test data. See analyses/README.md for the model and test setup. Equation or criterion basis: final_report/design-proposal.tex#eq:sunlight-period, eq:eclipse-period.

statements.text: The longest total eclipse within the assessed interval shall be at most $$eclipse_limit_s$$.
